welcome.tagline: Pull-up training, 15 minutes, 3 times a week.
welcome.title: Who is training?
welcome.private: Only a first name and age group are stored. Add more athletes later under Profile.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: First name
profile.nameHint: Only a first name is stored.
profile.levelHint: Tests set the level automatically. Change it here only if the coach says so.

today.title: Today's workout
today.lightWeek: Lighter week: one set less, to recover
today.note: Includes a 2-minute warm-up. Rest 60 seconds between sets.

first.title: Find the right level
first.body: Do a quick test so the app picks the right workout. It takes 2 minutes.

due.title: Test day!
due.body: Six workouts done since the last test. Time to see how much stronger you are.

break.title: Welcome back
break.body: It has been a while. A quick test makes sure the workout fits again. Going down a level after a break is normal.

workout.label: Workout
workout.weekReached: That's {n} this week. Weekly goal reached.
workout.weekProgress: That's {n} of {target} this week. Rest a day before the next one.

checkin.title: Quick check
checkin.intro: Two questions before you start. Saved on this phone only.
checkin.club: Gym training at the club today?
checkin.lighter: Lighter workout today: one set less on everything.
checkin.lighterChip: Lighter today: 1 set less | Lighter today: {n} sets less
checkin.restTitle: Rest is the better choice today.
checkin.restBody: Muscles get stronger while resting, and tired training is when most injuries happen.
checkin.restedBody: Good choice. Rest is part of training. See you next time!

reminder.title: Reminders
reminder.hint: A notification on these days at this time, also when the app is closed.
reminder.denied: Notifications are turned off for GymBuddy. Turn them on in the iPhone or iPad Settings.
reminder.appOnly: Reminders work in the GymBuddy app on iPhone and iPad. A website can't send them.

device.title: Only on this phone
device.intro: These settings stay on this device. They are not sent to the server and do not appear on other phones or tablets.
device.ageBandHint: Shows the KNGU goals for this age on the Progress tab.

growth.hint: One set less on everything, a warning on jumps and stretches, and a reminder about knee pain.
growth.todayBody: One set less today. Bones are growing faster than muscles, so flexibility drops and knees take more load. Pain just below the kneecap (common in boys of 10–15)? Fewer jumps, and see a doctor if it doesn't go away.
growth.jumpDetail: Fewer and lower jumps while he is growing fast; stop if a knee or heel hurts.
growth.flexDetail: Flexibility often drops during a growth spurt. Hold the stretch gently, never force it.

kngu.title: KNGU goals
kngu.intro: The KNGU physical-preparation goals for {band} year olds. These are goals for the whole age band, not for every week. Tick them off when he can do them.
kngu.source: Source: KNGU Technische Leerlijn Turnen Heren 2021. Ticks are saved on this phone only.
kngu.setBand: Choose his age band on the Profile screen to see the KNGU goals for his age.

injury.title: Injuries
injury.intro: Tap a sore or injured area. Exercises that load it are left out of today's workout and marked in the library.
injury.advice: This is not medical advice. With pain, swelling or an injury that doesn't get better, see a doctor or physio, and ask them when to train again.
injury.todayBody: Because of: {areas}. These exercises from your plan are skipped:
injury.detail: This exercise loads an injured area. Skip it until it has healed or a doctor or physio says it's fine.
injury.testWarning: Better wait with the test: it uses pull-ups and a hang, which load: {areas}. A test while injured gives the wrong level.

poses.title: Key poses
poses.intro: Every exercise drawing with its key positions. Use this to check the drawings with the coach.

library.commonPractice: Standard gymnastics conditioning; no source describes it in detail.

moves.title: All the moves
moves.intro: A library of gymnastics exercises for home: wall bars, pull-up bar, dip bar, bench and floor. Tap How to see each one.

test.title: Test day
test.intro: Warm up first. Do as many strict pull-ups as you can, rest 3 minutes, then time how long you can hold your chin over the bar.
test.up: Great work. New exercises are ready on the Today tab.
test.down: The plan now matches today's test. Building back up is normal after a break.
test.same: Keep going: the workout grows with you. {goal}

progress.streakWeeks: week in a row | weeks in a row
progress.streakHint: A week counts when it has 3 workouts.
progress.testHint: Every 2 weeks, with fresh arms after a warm-up. Only strict reps count.
progress.chartEmpty: After two tests you'll see a progress line here.
progress.chartOneMore: Record one more test to see the progress line.
progress.level5Dose: Main sets now: {sets} × {reps} pull-ups. A better test makes them harder.
progress.historyEmpty: Finished workouts and tests show up here.

account.title: Account
account.logoutUnsynced: {n} change(s) could not be synced yet and will be lost if you log out now. Log out anyway?

login.title: Log in
login.intro: One account per family. A parent logs in; the profiles and progress are on every device.
login.registerIntro: GymBuddy is invite-only. After you sign up, the admin approves your account before you can log in.
login.rememberOn: Stays logged in on this device as long as the app is opened at least once every {days} days.
login.rememberOff: You are logged out when you close the app. Use this on a shared device.
login.pendingBody: Your account is waiting for approval. You can log in as soon as the admin has approved it.

reason.not-approved: Your account is not approved (any more). Ask the admin if you think this is a mistake.
reason.expired: You have been logged out. Please log in again.

admin.title: Accounts
admin.intro: Only approved accounts can use GymBuddy. New sign-ups wait here until you approve them.
admin.confirmBlock: Block {email}? They are logged out on every device right away. You can approve them again later.
admin.confirmReject: Reject the request from {email}? The request is removed.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete {email} with all their athletes, workouts and tests? This cannot be undone.

errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: There is already an account with this email.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email or password is not right.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the email address and use a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.ACCOUNT_PENDING: Your account is still waiting for approval.
errors.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: This account has been blocked. Ask the admin if you think this is a mistake.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_APPROVED: Your account is not approved (any more).
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You cannot block or delete your own account.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the admin can do this.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach the server. Your progress is saved on this device and syncs later.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Please log in again to keep syncing.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Try again later.
